watch_entries.description:
List of files or directories to monitor on remote FTP servers. Each item specifies a host and a path, optionally marked as recursive (for directory trees). This corresponds directly to lines in ~/.ftpwatchrc as documented in ftpwatch(8). Each entry is rendered as 'host:R:path' or 'host:path'.

NOTE: The 'R:' prefix is included only if `recursive` is true, per documented format: `<Host>:R:<File>` for recursive watch of directories, else `<Host>:<File>` for single-file watch. No other formatting, options, or directives appear in the config file itself — only the host:R:path entries are configurable via this list. Passive mode and diff options are command-line flags passed when invoking ftpwatch(8), not stored in the config file, and thus not included here as config variables. See ftpwatch(8) CONFIGURATION FILES section. For passive mode or diff options, configure cron command line instead (e.g., '/usr/bin/ftpwatch -p -d-u'), but those are *not* config file content and therefore omitted from this schema/template for the .ftpwatchrc file only.
